answer: Trust-distance gating: endorsement weight halves per graph hop from a verified anchor, so sybils cannot pool capital on one thread of vouches; each fake identity needs its own hop-chain. Spinning up 40 sybils requires 40 independent hop-2 endorsements at about $35 stake each plus 3 confirmed epochs, costing over $1,400 and rising per-identity, not one shared bond. Failure mode: clustering sybils at a single jetty node to fake proximity is flagged once fan-out exceeds 8:1, burning the pigment of legitimacy and forfeiting the whole cluster's stake.
